title: Router v3 Classifier Output
description: Frozen output format for the retired v3 Pi prompt classifier. One JSON object per offline classify.py invocation, serialized as a single line and terminated with a trailing newline.

schema_version.description: Semver of this output contract. Offline validators compare against a known-good set.

primary.description: The cheapest acceptable route the classifier predicts for this prompt. The router dispatches the first attempt to this route.

candidates.description: Candidate routes with calibrated marginal confidence. Ordered by ascending ordinal cost (model_tier first, then effort). MUST include the primary route. Retained for offline evaluation and historical consumer compatibility.

confidence.description: Calibrated probability that primary is the cheapest acceptable route for this prompt (top-1 calibrated confidence).

reason.description: Short human-readable explanation of the route choice. Observability only; MUST NOT drive dispatch.

ambiguity_flag.description: Echo of the predicted ambiguity level, mirroring the corpus ambiguity field. Observability only.

predicted_domain.description: Classifier's best-guess domain tag. Observability only.

model_version.description: SHA of the classifier artifact that produced this output. Optional in contract-schema terms because offline tools may omit it.

ensemble_rule.description: For ensemble/confgate classifiers: which combination rule fired (lgb-confident | agree | t2-overrides | lgb-fallback | veto). Observability only; MUST NOT drive dispatch.

model_tier.description: Ordinal model tier. Ordering: mini < core < large.

effort.description: Ordinal reasoning effort tier. Ordering: none < low < medium < high.

confidence.description: Calibrated marginal probability that this candidate route is acceptable for the prompt.
